arStrings.szText: Increases Invigorating Strike Cast Speed by {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|%|]{/c} per stack.

{c_important}Invigorating Strike{/c} now deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_IMPACT}{/c} damage and every {c_number}[SF_31]rd{/c} cast grants {c_number}[SF_30]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} and {c_number}[SF_29]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Invigorating Strike{/c} is also a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill.

Casting {c_important}Invigorating Strike{/c} now dashes you to the target, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_IMPACT}{/c} damage and granting {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|%x|]{/c} increased Movement Speed for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADEB_MOVEMENT_SPEED_BONUS}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Invigorating Strike{/c} now cleaves, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_COLD}{/c} Cold damage and {c_important}{u}Chilling{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}{SF_23}%{/c} per attack.

Gain {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} additional Energy once every {c_number}[{SF_7}|1|]{/c} seconds after hitting an enemy with {c_important}Invigorating Strike{/c}. If a Close enemy is Crowd Controlled, the additional Energy gain is increased to {c_number}[{SF_13} + {SF_6}]{/c}.

Increases {c_important}Invigorating Strike{/c} Cast Speed by {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|%|]{/c} when hitting an enemy for the first time, up to {c_number}[{SF_32}*100*{SF_33}|%|]{/c}, for {c_number}[SF_34]{/c} seconds.
Hitting an enemy with {c_important}Invigorating Strike{/c} makes them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_8]{/c} seconds.

Heal for {c_number}[{SF_35}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life once every {c_number}[{SF_37}|1|]{/c} seconds for {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} seconds after hitting an enemy with {c_important}Invigorating Strike{/c}.
